chapters.prologue: Meet your ROV in the pool: arm, move, hold depth, use lights and take photos.
chapters.harbor: Your first job: hold steady at harbour pile inspection points and photograph old cracks clearly for the owner.
chapters.hull: Inspect hull scrapes. Slow down in poor visibility; keep out of gaps you cannot see into.
chapters.harbor_signoff: Handover check: take photos the next shift can relocate. Practise approaching structures while keeping an escape route.
chapters.offshore: Offshore wind tidal window: approach the jacket into the current, inspect anodes and stop work if the current is too strong.
chapters.reef: Replace research instruments: take ecological baseline photos, then recover and deploy equipment with the manipulator.
chapters.wreck: Survey the outside of an old freighter wreck. Do not enter the hull.
chapters.finale: Night harbour operation: recover the sealed case, deploy and verify. Your evidence determines the ending.
chapters.incident_jacket: Rising current, short-handed crew: assess aborting, retreat through an open exit and keep the tether clear of structures.
chapters.incident_wreck: Tether snagged on wreckage: do not pull hard from the surface. Follow it back to the snag and retrace your route.
chapters.incident_silt: Bottom contact stirred up sediment; no usable video. Return using depth, compass and tether direction.
chapters.incident_compass: Compass unreliable: disable heading hold and retreat using visual references, tether direction and depth.
chapters.incident_current: Current exceeds capability: abort and recover when position drifts. Do not fight it at full thrust.
